text:
zara: Quick follow-up from PM-2026-045 (cross-region LB/DNS retry surge). Posting consolidated action items + owners here. Root cause summary: LB reconcile bug + DNS TTL shadowing + TLS handshake retries under peak reconnects. Need tight owners + short ETAs.

ops-bot: Postmortem file created: PM-2026-045 https://redwood.internal/postmortems/PM-2026-045 :bookmark_tabs: 

brett: I'll take the LB reconcile bug. Hypothesis: reconcile loop reapplying an old route set when control-plane races with autoscaler. Plan: add a compare-and-swap guard and idempotent apply path. Mitigation: stop-reconcile flag for canary pools. ETA for mitigation patch: 2026-06-07 16:00 UTC.

akash: I'll own the DNS TTL shadowing piece. Observed hosts honoring local cached records longer than desired during canary flip, causing asymmetric traffic. Action: reduce TTL to 15s for canary flips + emit event-driven invalidation. ETA: 2026-06-07 18:00 UTC.

sam: TLS notes: region-c had handshake spike correlated with cert-rotation churn. I'll add a randomized rotation jitter + stronger retry backoff on edge handshake failures. Also add a histogram metric for handshake_latency by region. ETA: 2026-06-08 12:00 UTC.

leo: I'll do the canary verification matrix after brett's stop-reconcile. Probe matrix will run across: us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1. Probe command:
```
curl -sS -H "Host: api.redwood.internal" https://lb-probe.local/check -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n"
```
I'll post results CSV to the postmortem doc.

maria: I'll own alerts and runbooks. Adding alarms: edge_tls_handshake_retry, lb_reconcile_failure_count, dns_invalidation_failures. New composite alert: lb_reconcile_failure_count > 5 in 5m OR dns_invalidation_failures > 10 in 10m => paging. ETA: 2026-06-07 20:00 UTC.

dev-rel: I'll prepare a short customer note for impacted Dedicated tenants with the mitigation windows. ETA for publish: 2026-06-07 21:00 UTC.

irene: Action list below. Confirm or reassign. I'll convert to JIRA and add owners.

- ACTION brett: implement stop-reconcile flag + idempotent apply (mitigation) 1: ETA 2026-06-07 16:00 UTC
- ACTION akash: lower TTL for canary flips + invalidation hook 1: ETA 2026-06-07 18:00 UTC
- ACTION sam: jittered cert-rotation + handshake backoff + metric histogram 1: ETA 2026-06-08 12:00 UTC
- ACTION leo: post-mitigation probe matrix + verification report 1: ETA 2026-06-07 23:00 UTC
- ACTION maria: create composite alerts + runbook snippets 1: ETA 2026-06-07 20:00 UTC
- ACTION dev-rel: customer note + status page update 1: ETA 2026-06-07 21:00 UTC

brett: small addendum 1: will also add a short-circuit if reconcile attempts hit >3 retries in 60s to avoid thrash.

akash: note 1: I'll also instrument a metric for 'dns_ttl_shadow_count' so we can quantify post-fix.

ops-bot: Reminder: Follow-up sync scheduled: 2026-06-08 10:00 UTC.

brett: Update 2026-06-07 15:50 UTC: stop-reconcile flag merged to canary, deploying now to canary pool only. Rolling slow to avoid rate-throttles.

akash: Update 2026-06-07 17:30 UTC: TTL reduction pushed to canary DNS config, invalidation hook firing. Early telemetry shows drop in shadow_count from ~40/min to ~3/min.

leo: Update 2026-06-07 23:45 UTC: probe matrix run complete. Attached summary: all regions healthy, median time_total under 120ms, no asymmetric 5xx spikes. Will add csv link to PM-2026-045.

sam: Update 2026-06-08 11:50 UTC: cert-rotation jitter and handshake backoff rolled to region-c; handshake_retry down ~68%. Planning full edge roll at 2026-06-08 15:00 UTC.

maria: Update 2026-06-08 12:30 UTC: composite alerts added and tested (simulated alert). Runbook snippet: "If lb_reconcile_failure_count > 5 OR dns_invalidation_failures > 10 => escalate to networking-team, attach probe CSV, run rollback playbook." Linked in PM-2026-045.

irene: Thanks all. I'll create the grooming ticket for longer-term fixes (control-plane rate-limiting, conntrack tuning, retry-bucket heuristics) and mark these follow-ups as closed after verification. Reopen here if anything pops. :white_check_mark:
